input.sql:
SELECT
  f.id AS finding_id,
  a.hostname,
  v.cve,
  v.cvss,
  v.kev
FROM findings f
JOIN edges o ON o.src = f.id AND o.type = 'ON'
JOIN assets a ON o.dst = a.id
JOIN edges hv ON hv.src = f.id AND hv.type = 'OF'
JOIN vulns v ON hv.dst = v.id
WHERE v.kev = true OR v.cvss >= 9.0
ORDER BY v.cvss DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT
  f.id AS finding_id,
  a.hostname,
  v.cve,
  v.cvss,
  v.kev,
  z.name AS zone_name,
  z.trust
FROM findings f
JOIN edges o ON o.src = f.id AND o.type = 'ON'
JOIN assets a ON o.dst = a.id
JOIN zones z ON a.zone = z.id
JOIN edges hv ON hv.src = f.id AND hv.type = 'OF'
JOIN vulns v ON hv.dst = v.id
WHERE f.status = 'open' AND (v.kev = true OR v.cvss >= 9.0)
ORDER BY v.kev DESC, v.cvss DESC
LIMIT 30;

SELECT
  f.id AS finding_id,
  a.hostname,
  v.cve,
  v.cvss,
  v.kev,
  z.name AS zone_name
FROM findings f
JOIN edges o ON o.src = f.id AND o.type = 'ON'
JOIN assets a ON o.dst = a.id
JOIN zones z ON a.zone = z.id
JOIN edges hv ON hv.src = f.id AND hv.type = 'OF'
JOIN vulns v ON hv.dst = v.id
JOIN edges exp ON exp.dst = a.id AND exp.type = 'EXPOSES'
WHERE f.status = 'open'
ORDER BY v.kev DESC, v.cvss DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT f.id AS finding_id, v.cve, v.cvss, v.kev, a.hostname
FROM findings f
JOIN edges o ON o.src = f.id AND o.type = 'ON'
JOIN assets a ON o.dst = a.id
JOIN edges hv ON hv.src = f.id AND hv.type = 'OF'
JOIN vulns v ON hv.dst = v.id
JOIN edges can_reach ON can_reach.src = a.id
JOIN datastores ds ON can_reach.dst = ds.id
WHERE ds.crown_jewel = true AND f.status = 'open'
ORDER BY v.kev DESC, v.cvss DESC;
